topic: How can frequency planning address interference between satellite uplinks and broadband power line communication systems?
response: Frequency planning can address interference by allocating disjoint frequency bands to satellite uplinks and broadband power line communication systems, utilizing orthogonal polarizations, and implementing exclusion zones with a given isolation value from the center of the beam.
reference_context: Satellite communications suffer from intra-system interference, mitigated by separating frequency bands and using orthogonal polarizations to reduce interference between adjacent beams.
